project: The Real Windy City — Phase 6 source acquisition manifest

tier_definitions.1: Phase 1 cut-plan meetings (videos 1-2 exact windows; 6 meetings) + Sept 28 third reading (video 10). 7 recordings.

tier_definitions.3: Remaining catalog meetings with Phase 3/4 candidate cues (videos 4-9, 14).
tier_definitions.null: Catalog entry with no cut-plan window and no candidate cues in Phases 2-4; fetch only if later review requires.
